title: Quiz: How to Use Generators and yield in Python
description: In this quiz, you'll test your understanding of Python generators and the yield statement. With this knowledge, you'll be able to work with large datasets in a more Pythonic fashion, create generator functions and expressions, and build data pipelines.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Python generators . Generators and the Python yield statement can help you when you’re working with large datasets that might overwhelm your machine’s memory.
takeaways: Generators and the Python yield statement can help you when you’re working with large datasets that might overwhelm your machine’s memory.
Another use case is when you have a complex function that needs to maintain an internal state every time it’s called.
